mapper.sql: select run_id, task_id, task_name, task_type, device_id, trigger_type, status, percent, summary, hosts, started_at, ended_at from itm_sched_run
mapper.insert: insert into itm_sched_run (run_id, task_id, task_name, task_type, device_id, trigger_type, status, percent, summary, hosts, started_at, ended_at) values (#{runId}, #{taskId}, #{taskName}, #{taskType}, #{deviceId}, #{triggerType}, #{status}, #{percent}, #{summary}, #{hosts}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt})
mapper.delete: delete from itm_sched_run where started_at < #{before} and status not in ('DISPATCHED', 'RUNNING') limit #{limit}
